headline: DSI To Implement Single Export Portal For Strategic Commodities In 2027
seoTitle: DSI Single Export Portal For Strategic Commodities
metaDescription: Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI) will launch the NADI portal for coal, palm oil, and ferroalloy exports on January 1, 2027, to ensure data accuracy.
aiSummaryBullets: Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI) will launch the National Data & Intelligence (NADI) portal for strategic commodity exports on January 1, 2027.
The new system introduces a single-entry export process for coal, palm oil, and ferroalloy, requiring exporters to register beginning December 15, 2026.
DSI officials stated the system will impose a service fee while clarifying that commercial price negotiations between producers and buyers remain unchanged.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian government, through PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia (DSI), is preparing to centralize the export of key strategic commodities, including coal, palm oil, and ferroalloy. Starting January 1, 2027, these exports will be processed through a mandatory single-entry portal known as the National Data & Intelligence (NADI) system. Registration for exporters using this platform is scheduled to open on December 15, 2026. DSI is currently conducting socialization meetings with business stakeholders and collaborating with customs authorities to designate Dumai as the inaugural port for crude palm oil exports. The initiative aims to gather comprehensive exporter data and enhance oversight of export earnings, though DSI has not yet drawn conclusions regarding potential transaction value manipulation. DSI officials have emphasized that the implementation will not alter the commercial terms negotiated between sellers and international buyers.
whyItIsViral: The policy shift is being tracked by five independent news outlets with high coverage velocity as stakeholders prepare for the upcoming mandatory export system.
